Meet your personal team of AI agents. Ask anything, build anything, learn anything — all in one beautifully simple app.

Agentic AI is the fastest way to get expert help from smart agents built for real tasks. Write emails in your voice, debug code, plan a trip, draft a pitch, research a topic, or brainstorm your next big idea — every agent is an expert at what it does, and they actually work together.

WHY AGENTIC AI IS DIFFERENT 

Most AI apps give you one generic assistant. Agentic AI gives you an entire team of specialists you can put to work — individually or together. Pick one expert for a focused task, or build a team of up to four and watch them collaborate in real time. Each agent sees what the others said and adds its own expertise, like a smart team meeting in your pocket. 

BUILT-IN EXPERT AGENTS

• General Assistant — your everyday helper for any question 
• Writing Coach — emails, essays, captions, blog posts, cover letters
• Code Helper — write, explain, debug, refactor in any language 
• Research Analyst — deep answers with clear reasoning and context
• Creative Brainstormer — ideas, names, hooks, stories, campaigns 
• Study Buddy — tutor, summarize, explain any subject 
• Translator — natural, context-aware translation across languages
• Life Planner — goals, schedules, decisions, daily priorities

BUILD YOUR OWN AGENTS 

Create fully custom agents with your own persona, tone, and expertise. Perfect for your workflow, your brand, your voice. Unlimited with PRO. 
 
MULTI-AGENT TEAM SESSIONS 

This is where Agentic AI shines. Assemble a team — a Writer plus a Strategist plus a Researcher — and get a complete plan in one session. Stack a Coder and a Debugger to tag-team a bug. The agents read each other's answers, add unique value, and skip saying things that have already been said. Real collaboration, not just parallel chatter.
  
PRIVATE BY DESIGN 

Your conversations never train anyone's model. No accounts. No login. No profile harvesting. Your data lives on your device, in your control. 
 
WHAT PEOPLE LOVE

• Instant, expert-level answers across any subject
• Natural, human-quality writing in your own voice
• Real code that actually runs
• Thoughtful research you can trust
• Beautiful, distraction-free interface 
• Works the moment you open the app 
 
PRO FEATURES

Upgrade to Agentic AI PRO to unlock:
• Unlimited custom agents 
• Multi-agent team sessions
• All future PRO features 

Credit packs are available for power users who need more capacity on top of daily PRO usage. Pay only for what you need.
 
PERFECT FOR 

Students, writers, developers, founders, marketers, researchers, creators, professionals, and anyone who wants a smarter, more capable helper in their pocket. Whether you need a quick answer, a full draft, working code, a translation, a lesson, a plan, or a fresh creative angle — Agentic AI has the right expert for the job. 
 
WHAT YOU CAN DO TODAY 

• Draft an email that sounds like you 
• Turn a rough idea into a full business plan
• Debug a tricky piece of code
• Summarize a long document in seconds
• Translate a message naturally
• Generate names, taglines, and hooks 
• Plan your week, goals, or next trip 
• Learn any subject from first principles 
• Brainstorm with an entire team of experts 

Download Agentic AI today and meet your new team of smart assistants. One app. Every expert. Unlimited possibilities.
